guides.title: Technische Documentatie & Gidsen
guides.subtitle: Volledige architectuurreferentie, stapsgewijze Admin-handleiding en productie-integratie van @bloume/id SDK & Server.
guides.searchPlaceholder: Zoek concepten, adminpagina's, SDK-methoden, foutcodes (401, CORS, HMAC, GeoLite2)...
guides.noResults: Geen documentatiesectie gevonden voor uw zoekopdracht.
guides.ch1Subtitle: Waarom self-hosted deterministische identificatie met 104 signalen beter presteert dan cookies en gesloten SaaS.
guides.ch1IntroTitle: Why BloumeID instead of cookies or commercial SaaS?
guides.ch1IntroDesc: Browsers clear third-party cookies aggressively and SaaS fingerprinting vendors charge per API call while exporting visitor telemetry outside your perimeter. BloumeID runs 100% inside your own Docker infrastructure with deterministic hardware correlation and zero usage fees.
guides.ch1CompareCookie: Third-Party Cookies: Blocked by Safari ITP / Firefox ETP and wiped on Incognito exit. Zero cross-browser persistence.
guides.ch1CompareSaas: Closed SaaS APIs: Per-event billing, external telemetry custody, and opaque confidence models outside your control.
guides.ch1CompareBloume: BloumeID Self-Hosted: 104 deterministic browser + GPU signals, sub-millisecond Valkey CIDR threat trie, local GeoLite2 MMDB, and unlimited requests.
guides.pipelineSubtitle: From browser signal capture to real-time cryptographic verification and webhook delivery in under 15 ms.
guides.phase1Desc: Collects 104 signals into fullHash + hardwareHash, adds a timestamped single-use nonce, and posts to POST /api/v1/fingerprint.
guides.phase2Desc: Looks up client IP against 54,000+ Tor, VPN, Proxy, and Datacenter CIDR blocks plus local MaxMind GeoLite2 City/ASN MMDB databases.
guides.phase3Desc: Resolves vis_<snowflake> deterministically via Level 1 fullHash, Level 2 hardwareHash + /24 subnet cross-browser link, or Level 3 new visitor.
guides.phase4Desc: Evaluates custom security rules (ALLOW / CHALLENGE / BLOCK), dispatches HMAC-SHA256 webhooks, and exposes req_<snowflake> to GET /api/v1/events/[id].
guides.archSignalWhat: Captures Canvas 2D double-render geometry, WebGL/WebGPU GPU limits, AudioContext oscillators, CSS media matrix, media codecs, fonts, and headless/tamper probes.
guides.archSignalWhy: Builds a stable browser fullHash and cross-browser hardwareHash resilient to private browsing and cookie clearing.
guides.archSignalHow: Toggle per-site collectors in Sites & API Keys -> Actions, or exclude signals client-side via options.exclude.
guides.archReconcileWhat: Generates time-ordered prefixed IDs (site_, vis_, req_, rule_) and links returning visitors across fullHash or hardwareHash + /24 subnet.
guides.archReconcileWhy: Prevents sequential integer enumeration leaks while tying Chrome, Firefox, and Safari sessions on the same device.
guides.archReconcileHow: Audit linked browsers, devices, and IP history directly in Visitors & Team -> visitor detail view.
guides.archNetworkTitle: Valkey CIDR Threat Trie & Local GeoLite2 MMDB
guides.archNetworkWhat: Indexes 54,000+ VPN, Tor exit nodes, proxies, and cloud ASNs in memory next to local MaxMind GeoLite2 City & ASN databases.
guides.archNetworkWhy: Delivers zero-latency IP enrichment and bot/anonymizer flags without calling third-party IP intelligence APIs.
guides.archNetworkHow: Trigger sync or configure MAXMIND_LICENSE_KEY in Settings -> Threat Feeds & GeoLite2.
guides.ch1SecurityCallout: Never rely on browser signatures alone for trust: bid_pub_ identifies the site and combines with strict CORS Origin validation, Valkey sliding-window rate limits, and Redis single-use nonces (±5 min). Sensitive authorization MUST always call /api/v1/events/[requestId] with bid_sec_.
guides.ch1PerfCallout: The UMD bundle is self-hosted directly from /sdk/v1/bloumeid.js with zero runtime dependencies. Local radix trie + MMDB lookups avoid external DNS/TLS round-trips.
guides.ch2Subtitle: Doel, concrete gebruiksscenario's, stapsgewijze configuratie en veelvoorkomende valkuilen per pagina.
guides.modDashboardGoal: Centralize real-time telemetry KPIs, geographic distribution, platform/OS split, and recent high-risk detections across one or all sites.
guides.modDashboardUseCases: Daily SOC monitoring, spotting sudden credential-stuffing spikes by ASN/country, and comparing Chrome vs. Safari vs. Headless traffic.
guides.modDashboardSteps: Use the top toolbar to filter by Site, time window (24h / 7d / 30d), view presets (Full Telemetry, Executive, SOC, Network), and live auto-refresh (5s / 15s / 60s).
guides.modDashboardPitfalls: When deploying a brand-new instance with zero events, cards explicitly render clean empty states until your first site collects live SDK traffic.
guides.modSitesGoal: Manage isolated tenant websites, CORS domain allowlists, per-site collector flags, public bid_pub_ keys, and hashed bid_sec_ secret keys.
guides.modSitesUseCases: Separating staging from production traffic, enabling *.bloume.fr wildcard CORS origins, or rotating compromised secret keys instantly.
guides.modSitesSteps: Click Create Site (top sidebar CTA or /sites), set allowed domains (including wildcards like *.example.com), configure alert threshold (0–5) & webhooks, then click Actions to edit existing settings.
guides.modSitesPitfalls: Leaving allowed domains blank or mistyping the scheme/port causes 403 CORS rejections in the browser. Always store the newly created bid_sec_ key in your backend secrets manager immediately.
guides.modEventsGoal: Search and inspect every individual req_<snowflake> fingerprint event with full forensic telemetry and confidence scores.
guides.modEventsUseCases: Investigating a disputed checkout, verifying why an account triggered a block rule, or debugging missing client signals.
guides.modEventsSteps: Filter by site, risk level, or req_ / vis_ / IP query, then click any row to open the Forensic Inspector drawer showing Canvas/WebGL hashes, ASN, JA4 correlation, and matched rules.
guides.modEventsPitfalls: Trusting client-passed metadata (linkedId/tag) without filtering: treat linkedId as untrusted user input unless validated by your backend.
guides.modVisitorsGoal: Inspect consolidated vis_<snowflake> profiles across multiple visits, IP subnets, linkedIds, and cross-browser matches.
guides.modVisitorsSteps: Open any vis_<snowflake> profile to trace firstSeenAt vs. lastSeenAt timestamps, cross-browser links, device history, and associated risk flags.
guides.modVisitorsUseCases: Detecting multi-account bonus abuse where a single user switches between Firefox, Chrome, and Incognito mode on the same GPU.
guides.modVisitorsPitfalls: Assuming a visitor ID must never change across OS reinstalls; cross-browser matching requires stable hardwareHash signals and overlapping /24 network context.
guides.modSignalsGoal: Monitor automated security verdicts: Bot / Headless Chromium, Incognito detection, Tampering, Tor, VPN, Proxy, and Datacenter ASN activity.
guides.modSignalsUseCases: Separating genuine privacy-conscious VPN users from automated datacenter scraping farms or spoofed WebGL bots.
guides.modSignalsSteps: Review detection breakdowns over time, click flagged signatures to pivot into matching /events, and tune thresholds before writing automated blocking rules.
guides.modSignalsPitfalls: Blocking all VPN traffic blindly can hurt enterprise customers; combine VPN flags with headless/tamper signals or step-up MFA challenges.
guides.modRulesGoal: Create deterministic server-side rules per site (ALLOW, CHALLENGE, BLOCK) based on risk score, Tor/VPN/Bot flags, country, ASN, or tamper detection.
guides.modRulesUseCases: Blocking checkout from Tor exit nodes, requiring captcha/MFA when bot or tamper score >= 3, or whitelisting internal corporate ASNs.
guides.modRulesSteps: Pick target Site -> New Rule -> define condition priority, signal thresholds, and verdict (ALLOW / CHALLENGE / BLOCK). Test in audit mode before activating hard blocks.
guides.modRulesPitfalls: Ordering low-priority BLOCK rules ahead of corporate ALLOW rules, or forgetting that server-side verification checks request.ruleAction from BloumeIDServer.
guides.modSecurityGoal: Audit control-plane hardening: ADMIN_MASTER_KEY authentication state, timing-safe comparison checks, Redis/Valkey rate-limit posture, and nonce replay protection.
guides.modSecurityUseCases: Verifying production readiness before public launch and monitoring failed login / rate-limit blocks.
guides.modSecuritySteps: Confirm Redis/Valkey connectivity is healthy, ensure non-default ADMIN_MASTER_KEY and ADMIN_SESSION_SECRET are configured, and inspect blocked IP burst counters.
guides.modSecurityPitfalls: Deploying with the development fallback ADMIN_MASTER_KEY in production or disabling reverse-proxy X-Forwarded-For trust improperly.
guides.modWebhooksGoal: Receive asynchronous HTTP POST notifications for high-risk identifications or rule triggers, cryptographically signed with X-BloumeID-Signature.
guides.modWebhooksUseCases: Invalidating user sessions in real time, alerting Slack/SIEM on account-takeover patterns, or flagging orders in fulfillment pipelines.
guides.modWebhooksSteps: Set your HTTPS webhook endpoint & strong secret in Site settings, verify delivery logs on /webhooks, and validate HMAC-SHA256 headers strictly on your server.
guides.modWebhooksPitfalls: Accepting webhook payloads without verifying HMAC-SHA256 using crypto.timingSafeEqual allows attackers to forge fraud alerts.
guides.ch2WebhookCallout: Always read the raw request body bytes before JSON parsing and compare X-BloumeID-Signature (sha256=<hex>) via crypto.timingSafeEqual to guarantee zero timing side-channel leaks.
guides.modUsageGoal: Track request volume per site across Native/ThumbmarkJS and Fingerprint.com API modes and export compliance reports.
guides.modUsageUseCases: Capacity planning for PostgreSQL/Valkey sizing and tracking migration progress across frontend apps.
guides.modUsageSteps: Filter by billing/rolling 30-day period, inspect per-site throughput, and download CSV or JSON snapshots.
guides.modUsagePitfalls: Underestimating peak bursts during marketing campaigns; ensure PostgreSQL retention & Redis memory limits match peak daily events.
guides.modSettingsGoal: Manage MaxMind GeoLite2 (.mmdb) updates, 54,000+ CIDR threat feed synchronization, retention policies, and active runtime parameters.
guides.modSettingsUseCases: Bootstrapping IP geolocation right after container startup and refreshing Tor/VPN lists daily.
guides.modSettingsSteps: Provide MAXMIND_LICENSE_KEY in your environment if using authenticated MaxMind downloads, then click Sync Threat Feeds & Update GeoLite2 to populate /app/data/geoip.
guides.modSettingsPitfalls: Running a container without a persistent volume mounted at /app/data/geoip forces MMDB databases to re-download after every container recreate.
guides.modHealthGoal: Inspect live PostgreSQL, Valkey/Redis, GeoLite2 MMDB, and Threat Trie health probes alongside dynamic BloumeID version changelogs.
guides.modHealthUseCases: Coolify/Kubernetes readiness probes (/api/health) and verifying after upgrades that all migrations and MMDB files loaded cleanly.
guides.modHealthSteps: Verify green status indicators on /health before routing production traffic; consult /releases for breaking notes or new collector capabilities.
guides.modHealthPitfalls: Pointing load balancer healthchecks to authenticated admin pages instead of public GET /api/health.
guides.ch3Subtitle: Zero-dependency browsercollectie, dubbele compatibiliteitsmodi, Zero-Trust serververificatie en volledige signaal- & fouttabel.
guides.sdkInstallDesc: Install @bloume/id from npm (ESM/CJS/TypeScript with zero runtime dependencies) or load the self-hosted UMD bundle directly from your BloumeID server at /sdk/v1/bloumeid.js.
guides.sdkDualDesc: Switch existing codebases in minutes without rewriting business logic: BloumeID ships both a ThumbmarkJS-compatible API and a Fingerprint.com Pro-compatible client.
guides.sdkThumbmarkDesc: Ideal for lightweight migrations from ThumbmarkJS — returns deterministic thumbmark hashes, components, and optional server identification.
guides.sdkFpDesc: Drop-in replacement for @fingerprintjs/fingerprintjs-pro supporting apiKey (bid_pub_...), endpoint, tag, and linkedId.
guides.ch3MigrationCallout: Already using Fingerprint.com or ThumbmarkJS? Open the built-in AI Migration Assistant (/migrate) to generate a custom codebase refactor prompt pre-filled with your site keys.
guides.sdkServerDesc: Use BloumeIDServer with your secret bid_sec_ key to verify requestId authenticity and retrieve authoritative Smart Signals before granting sensitive actions.
guides.ch3ServerSecurityCallout: NEVER trust visitorId, incognito, or bot flags sent directly from the client browser! Attackers can spoof JSON payloads in devtools. Send ONLY the opaque requestId to your backend and verify it server-to-server with BLOUMEID_SECRET_KEY (bid_sec_).
guides.signalsTableTitle: 4. Reference Matrix of the 104 Signals & Filtering
guides.signalsTableDesc: Use options.exclude (e.g. ['fonts', 'audio']) if your threat model requires minimal latency or strict privacy exemptions.
guides.sigSig1: Double-render geometry hash, text metrics, emoji ascent/descent subpixel hash, winding rule
guides.sigPurp1: Detects software rendering VMs, anti-fingerprinting canvas noise injection, and headless Chrome
guides.sigSig2: Unmasked GPU vendor/renderer, shader precision hash, max texture/viewport, WebGPU adapter & limits
guides.sigPurp2: Core pillar linking Chrome, Firefox, and Safari on the same physical GPU
guides.sigSig3: OfflineAudioContext dynamics compressor sum, H.264/HEVC/AV1/VP9/AAC/Opus capability matrix
guides.sigPurp3: Separates real desktop audio DSP stacks from headless containers lacking media pipelines
guides.sigSig4: 85+ OS font width/height probes, color-gamut (P3/rec2020), forced-colors, pointer/hover/prefers-contrast
guides.sigPurp4: Reveals OS mismatch (e.g., Linux server spoofing a Windows User-Agent without Windows fonts)
guides.sigSig5: hardwareConcurrency, deviceMemory, screen geometry, colorDepth, timezone Intl, touch points, speech voices
guides.sigPurp5: Cross-validates declared device class against actual hardware capabilities
guides.sigSig6: webdriver flag, Playwright/Puppeteer globals, prototype tampering, timing/lies consistency, WebRTC ICE
guides.sigPurp6: Flags automated browsers, stealth plugins, and tampered navigator descriptors immediately
guides.sdkErrorsTitle: 5. HTTP & SDK Error Codes + Graceful Fail-Safe Fallback
guides.sdkErrorsDesc: Handle transient network or rate-limit responses safely so legitimate users are never locked out by a client timeout.
guides.err401Cause: Invalid/inactive bid_pub_ key on collect, wrong bid_sec_ key on server verify, or expired admin session.
guides.err401Fix: Verify the exact bid_pub_ / bid_sec_ key in /sites and check for trailing whitespace in env vars.
guides.err403Meaning: CORS Origin mismatch or Anti-Replay failure
guides.err403Cause: Request Origin header does not match allowed domains on the site, or timestamp/nonce replay window (±5 min) was exceeded.
guides.err403Fix: Add the exact frontend domain (or *.domain.tld) in Sites -> Actions and ensure client clocks & single-use nonces are fresh.
guides.err429Cause: Client IP or site exceeded configured Valkey sliding-window quota per minute.
guides.err429Fix: Respect Retry-After header, debounce duplicate SDK calls on mount, and tune site rate limits if needed.
guides.err503Cause: PostgreSQL migrations in progress, container restarting, or Valkey temporarily unreachable.
guides.err503Fix: Wrap frontend collection & backend verification in bounded timeouts (e.g. 2,500 ms) with fail-open or step-up challenge fallback.
guides.sdkFailsafeDesc: Never block login or checkout indefinitely if an ad-blocker intercepts /api/v1/fingerprint or network latency spikes: bound SDK calls with timeoutMs and fallback safely.
guides.ch3FailsafePerfCallout: Set timeout: 2500 on client SDK calls and catch errors gracefully so an ad-blocker or transient 503 never breaks checkout conversion.
